basic_details.job_title: DIHAR Paid Intern Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Defence Institute of High-altitude Research (DIHAR), a DRDO establishment at Leh Ladakh (U.T), is offering 3 paid internship positions for B.E./B.Tech students in the 7th/8th semester and M.Tech students in the 1st/2nd year. Applications go by email only to [email protected], and the last date for receipt of application is 8 December 2026. No hard copy is accepted.

post_wise_qualification.post_name: Paid Intern: BE / B.Tech / M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering / Electrical Engineering / Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering / Electronic & Communication Engineering / Computer Science Engineering / Information Technology Engineering / Civil Engineering

qualification.details: Qualification: BE/B.Tech students pursuing an undergraduate engineering degree (7th/8th Semester) or a post graduate engineering degree (M.Tech 1st / 2nd year) in the respective discipline from a recognised Indian University/Institute. Academic record: good academic track record with 7.5 CGPA or equivalent or more, continuously maintained in all previous semesters from AICTE/UGC approved universities/institutes. A copy is to be enclosed. No equivalent qualification will be considered. Age limit: below 28 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and no age relaxation. Duration: 06 months. The Completion Certificate is issued only at the end of 06 months from the date of joining. Location of internship: DIHAR Leh / DIHAR Base Station Chandigarh. The number of positions is indicative and may increase or decrease at the discretion of the institute. | For the discipline-specific eligibility of each branch, candidates should refer to the official notification.

selection_process: Selection will be made from the applied candidates based on the marks scored in previous exams and an online/telephonic interview / interaction as required. The notice states that selection will be based entirely on merit. Selected students will be notified about the joining procedure only through the mail ID given in the application form. No communication will be undertaken for rejected students.
important_instructions: Stipend is applicable only when the student is present at the Lab for a minimum of 15 working days per month. The stipend is paid in two instalments: the first after 03 months of internship and the second after completion of 06 months. It is paid directly to the student's bank account. Project internship for B.E/B.Tech/M.Tech can be extended further by 8-10 months without payment of stipend. A Certificate of Completion is awarded on successful completion, which includes clearing evaluation of project work, submission of the project report and completion of other formalities. A student who leaves in between gets no certificate and no payment. No boarding or lodging expenses are admissible. Interns must follow the Lab guidelines. The internship will be terminated if a student is found involved in disciplinary activities. DIHAR/DRDO has no obligation to offer employment, and an intern cannot claim a right to employment on completing the internship. Incomplete or erroneous applications, or those received after the due date, will be rejected, and no further communication will be entertained. The management reserves the right to change the vacancy positions or selection criteria at any point during the selection process without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: About DIHAR
content_sections.text: The notice describes DIHAR as a Centre of the Armaments & Research Development Establishment (ARDE), a premier establishment of the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO). It works on high altitude trial and testing and cold-arid area technologies. This is a government research establishment, and the posts are internships, not regular jobs.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send good scanned copies of the duly filled application, together with the Reference / Request letter from the college for Paid Internship (as per the attached format), to the Centre Head, DIHAR, through email only. Email address: [email protected] Email subject: Application for paid internship with branch/discipline for which the candidate is applying Form: "Format for Application for DRDO Paid Internship Scheme" attached to the notice (page 4), with a passport size photo (4.5 x 3.5cm) affixed College letter: to be printed on the college letter head and signed by the Principal / Head of Department / Institution with office seal (format on page 5 of the notice) No hard copy will be accepted as application for the internship. Emails received beyond the last date and time will not be considered. The application format asks for name, date of birth, Aadhar number, college name, address and contact number, branch/discipline, degree with semester/year, CGPA or equivalent marks, achievements (awards or professional membership, if any), nationality (Indian), permanent and local address, contact numbers, email ID and a checklist of enclosures. For further clarification, the notice gives the numbers 0172-2639800 / 2638900.

content_sections.text: Documents to be sent with the email (good scanned copies): Filled application form as per the attached format Copy of the mark sheet of last semesters Copy of the Aadhar card Reference / Request letter from college for Paid Internship as per the attached format Brief bio-data in less than 300 words highlighting achievements Documents named for the time of joining (selected students only): All B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech previous semesters/year mark sheets in original for verification Original copy of the Reference / Request letter from college Original copy of the Bonafide Certificate from the College No Objection Certificate (NOC) from college authorities (in original) on college letterhead, stating that the student will be relieved for the internship at DIHAR (DRDO) and will be present for a minimum 15 working days every month Police verification certificate from hometown / place of residence Undertaking for adherence to the Indian Official Secrets Act, 1923, and an undertaking to follow the IT Rules and Regulations applicable for the Ministry of Defence and its amendments (formats given in the notice) Bank account details for transfer of stipend Original Aadhar Card and college ID card for verification 3 passport size colour photos Original documents will be returned immediately after verification. Any other documents required will be communicated to the student at the time of selection/joining.

rows.details: Format for Application for DRDO Paid Internship Scheme

faq.question: Q1. How many paid internship positions has DIHAR announced?
faq.answer: DIHAR has announced 03 positions for the combined branches listed. The notice calls the number indicative; it may increase or decrease at the discretion of the institute.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the DIHAR paid internship?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of application is 08 December 2026. Emails received beyond the stated date and time will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the DIHAR internship?
faq.answer: Students must be in the 7th/8th semester of BE/B.Tech or the 1st/2nd year of M.Tech in the respective discipline, from a recognised Indian University/Institute. A CGPA of 7.5 or equivalent or more is required in all previous semesters.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 28 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the stipend?
faq.answer: The monthly stipend is Rs. 5,000/-. It is paid in two instalments, after 03 months and after 06 months, and only if the student is present at the Lab for at least 15 working days per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email scanned copies of the filled application and the college reference letter to [email protected]. The subject must be "Application for paid internship with branch/discipline for which the candidate is applying". Hard copies are not accepted.

faq.question: Q7. How are interns selected?
faq.answer: Selection is based on marks scored in previous exams and an online/telephonic interview / interaction as required, entirely on merit. Selected students are told about joining by email.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the internship be held?
faq.answer: The location of the internship is DIHAR Leh / DIHAR Base Station Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q9. Does the internship lead to a job at DRDO?
faq.answer: No. The notice says DIHAR/DRDO has no obligation to offer employment, and an intern cannot claim a right to employment on completing the internship.

faq.question: Q10. When does the internship start?
faq.answer: The internship is listed to start on 1st Jan 2027, and selected students are to be informed in the 2nd-3rd week of December 2026.
